data.long_description:
With only 147 villas in the entire community, opportunities to secure a home in this exclusive equestrian enclave are becoming increasingly rare. This is currently the lowest-priced 4-bedroom villa available within Al Habtoor Polo Residences and the last remaining developer-owned unit at this price point, making it an exceptional opportunity for both end-users and investors.

Key Highlights:

•Last Remaining Unit at This Price Point
•Currently the Lowest-Priced 4-Bedroom Villa Available in the Community
•Directly from the Developer – Save AED 113,000 with No Buyer Commission
•Many comparable villas are now offered as resales with a mandatory 2% buyer fee
•Excellent Opportunity for Renovation, Value Enhancement & Future Resale Potential
•Built-Up Area: 3681 sq. ft
•Arrange a private community tour, including a visit to the stables and the opportunity to experience the equestrian lifestyle firsthand

Community Highlights:

•Situated within the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club
•Access to luxury 5-star hotel and resort facilities
•Four professional polo fields and world-class equestrian amenities
•Riding school, stables, and horse-training facilities
•Swimming pools, fitness centres, and wellness amenities
•Fine dining restaurants, cafés, and leisure venues
•Landscaped parks, walking trails, and expansive green spaces
•Family-friendly environment with a strong sense of community

Contact Adrian Bak, Community Expert, to arrange your private tour of Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club.
